# VEMU Institute of Technology

> VEMU Institute of Technology is a premier engineering college in Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh, offering accredited B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, and MCA programs with strong industry placements and academic excellence.

Located in Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh, VEMU is an AICTE-accredited institution affiliated with JNTUA, recognized by NIRF rankings. The institute emphasizes technical education, industry partnerships, and holistic student development through governance structures and quality assurance mechanisms.
